content.en: Got everything. Good thing we helped out that vendor and that staff member earlier.
content.zh: 东西都齐了，幸好帮了那位摊主还有那个工作人员。

content.en: Heave-ho. I’ll leave the extinguisher here. What do we even need all this stuff for?
content.zh: 嘿咻。灭火器我放到这里了。我们要这些东西干什么啊？

content.en: I just ran into a local puppet-maker around here. The thread he uses for his puppets is very similar to the one I saw on the plane.
content.zh: 刚才我在周边遇到了一位本地木偶匠人，他用来制作木偶的丝线和我之前在飞机上看到的非常类似。

content.en: The material is like spider silk: it melts when heated, and becomes brittle when exposed to cold.
content.zh: 这种丝线材质类似蛛丝，遇热会融化，遇冷会脆化。

content.en: Right, the people had those threads implanted in their bodies!
content.zh: 对了，那些人身体里被植入了丝线！

content.en: Exactly. We can’t start a fire inside a plane, but we can lower the temperature in a way that doesn’t threaten the plane’s safety.
content.zh: 是的，我们不能在飞机里放火，但却可以在不威胁飞机安全的情况下降温。

content.en: The lantern stall uses paper and is close to a heat source, so it’s considered a high fire-risk stall type.
content.zh: 花灯摊位有纸制品且靠近热源，属于易引发火灾的摊位类型。

content.en: Ah! So if we spray the controlled people on the plane with this...
content.zh: 啊！只要我们拿这个喷飞机上被控制的人——

content.en: Yes. My guess is it should temporarily disable their ability to move.
content.zh: 是的，我推测应该可以令他们暂时失去行动能力！

content.en: Haha! You’re amazing! Shifu was totally right about you!
content.zh: 哈哈！你真是太厉害了！师父果然是对的！

content.en: Uh, so… what’s the speaker for?
content.zh: 欸，那这个音响是做什么的？

content.en: This is just my guess.
content.zh: 这只是我的一个猜想。

content.en: What do you mean?
content.zh: 什么意思？

content.en: During my investigation just now, I found a booth set up by the Jile Troupe at the festival grounds.
content.zh: 刚才探索时，我找到了极乐戏团设立在会场的一个摊位。

content.en: One of the staff told me that the troupe members wanted a certain drumbeat to be looped through speakers near the booth.
content.zh: 一位工作人员告诉我，戏团的成员希望在摊位附近的音响循环播放一种鼓点。

content.en: A <color=orange>drumbeat</color>? Now that you mention it, I remember hearing a faint, low sound on the plane too…
content.zh: <color=orange>鼓点</color>？说起来，我之前在飞机上就一直能听到一种很轻很低的响声来着......

content.en: Yeah. After fixing the speaker, I listened closely. The beat playing at the booth was exactly <color=orange>the same as the one from the plane</color>.
content.zh: 嗯，刚才我修好音响后听了一下，摊位和飞机上播放的确实是<color=orange>同一种鼓点</color>。

content.en: In nature, most web-building spiders have poor eyesight. They rely on vibrations to sense the position and state of prey caught in their web.
content.zh: 自然界中，大多数结网蜘蛛通常视力不佳，它们靠震动来感受猎物在蛛网上的位置和状态。

content.en: What does that have to do with the drumbeat?
content.zh: 这和那个鼓点有什么关系呢？

content.en: Earlier, you mentioned that the controlled people had threads implanted in them. That means the troupe’s puppetmasters weren’t controlling them externally, but rather using some method to manipulate the threads inside their bodies directly.
content.zh: 你之前提到过，被控制的人是被植入了丝线。也就是说戏团的偶师并不是从外部控制的它们，而是使用某种方法直接调动了人们体内的丝线。

content.en: The drumbeat likely isn’t what the puppetmasters use to command the puppets. It’s a fixed background sound, and in all the loops I remember, it never changed.
content.zh: 鼓点应该不是偶师用来主导人偶行动的控制器，因为它是固定的背景声，在我几次循环的记忆中也都没有改变。

content.en: But the troupe’s demand shows that the drumbeat is still necessary for the control process.
content.zh: 但戏团的需求，说明鼓声对于控制过程也是必要的。

content.en: I suspect that beat might serve as some kind of frequency-tuning medium.
content.zh: 我猜想那种鼓点或许充当了一种调频媒介。

content.en: Frequency-tuning? What does that mean?
content.zh: 调频？那又是什么意思？

content.en: Remember how I said spiders rely on vibrations to sense movement on their webs? I think what happened on the plane is the reverse of that.
content.zh: 还记得我之前说蜘蛛是靠震动感受蛛网情况的吗？我认为飞机上的过程是相反的。

content.en: The drumbeat works like a constant vibration, keeping the controlled individuals in a kind of <color=orange>shared "web": a unified state of control.</color>
content.zh: 鼓点就像是一段持续的震动一样，让被控制的人们，维持成了<color=orange>“蛛网”般的联合性受控状态。</color>

content.en: My brain feels like it’s about to explode…
content.zh: 我感觉我的脑子要爆炸了......

content.en: Sorry. It’s okay. All of this is just a theory anyway.
content.zh: 抱歉，都没关系的。这些归根结底也都是猜想。

content.en: But regardless, keeping the drumbeat going is something the troupe needs.
content.zh: 但无论如何，维持鼓点的节奏都是戏团所需要的。

content.en: Which means all we have to do is disrupt it. Maybe some rock music will do the trick.
content.zh: 而我们只需要破坏掉它就好了，或许一点摇滚乐就能搞定。

content.en: Yes!
content.zh: 好！

content.en: Then let’s get ready to use the Mirror to return to the plane!
content.zh: 那我们准备用明镜回到飞机上吧！

content.en: Once we’re there, I’ll clear the way with a fire extinguisher, and you’ll blast music through the speaker to break the beat?
content.zh: 待会儿上去之后我拿灭火器开路，你用音响播放曲子破坏鼓点？

content.en: Yeah. Once the puppets are neutralized, can you take down the puppeteer?
content.zh: 嗯。无效化那些人偶之后，你能对付那个偶师吗？

content.en: If I don’t have to worry about hurting the controlled people, then absolutely! I hold the highest unbroken win streak in combat at our temple!
content.zh: 不用顾及被控制的人，那就肯定没问题！我可是我们道观武斗最高连胜记录保持者！

content.en: Alright, let’s go.
content.zh: 好，那我们走吧。

content.en: That’s why it’s stocked with a lot of CO₂ extinguishers. These extinguishers can be used in small areas inside the cabin, and they can rapidly lower the temperature.
content.zh: 所以摊位里配备了不少二氧化碳灭火器。这种灭火器可以在飞机内小范围使用，能够快速降温。
